script.hook: 50 lakh ka ghar, aur bill 1 crore ka.

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill

visual.prompt: A small new apartment building at dusk, and behind it a towering mountain of rupee notes twice as tall as the building, warm city lights, dramatic wide shot, illustrated story style, no text

scenes.vo: 50 lakh ka ghar, aur bill 1 crore ka. Yeh koi galti nahi, 20 saal ke home loan ka seedha hisaab hai. Jo flat aap 50 lakh mein lete ho, uske lagbhag double aap bank ko dete ho. Aur sabse ajeeb baat yeh hai, ki pehle kai saal ghar asal mein aapka hota hi nahi.

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill

visual.prompt: A cramped rented flat in the evening, a young couple in their early thirties, Amit in an office shirt and Neha in a kurta, sitting on a sofa with BETI playing on the floor, PAPA in a kurta nodding approvingly, hopeful mood, no text

scenes.vo: Amit aur Neha ki kahani suniye. Dono naukri karte hain, ghar mein ek chhoti beti hai. Kiraaye ke ghar mein makaan maalik har saal kiraya badha deta tha. Ek shaam Neha ne kaha, bas, ab apna ghar lenge. Papa ne bhi haan mein haan milayi, kiraaya bekaar jaata hai, EMI toh apni hai.

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill

visual.prompt: Inside a bank branch in daytime, BANK UNCLE behind a counter sliding a thick loan file towards Amit and Neha, Amit holding a pen ready to sign, a set of new house keys on the counter, cheerful but serious mood, no text

scenes.vo: Bank mein Bank Uncle ne file kholi, aur bade aaram se samjhaya. Loan 50 lakh ka, 20 saal ke liye, 8 percent byaaj par. Har mahine EMI banegi 41,822 rupaye. Amit ne salary dekhi, mann mein hisaab lagaya, haan, ho jaayega. Signature hue, aur kuch hafton mein chaabi haath mein thi.

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill

visual.prompt: A bright new empty flat on housewarming day, MUMMY in a saree handing out sweets from a box, BETI running across a sunlit room, Amit and Neha smiling at the door, marigold garlands at the entrance, joyful morning light, no text

scenes.vo: Grihapravesh ke din sab khush the. Mummy ne mithai baanti, beti naye kamre mein idhar udhar daud rahi thi. Kisi ne yeh nahi poocha ki 20 saal mein total kitna jaayega. Kyunki EMI hamesha chhota number lagta hai. Total woh number hai jo neend uda deta hai.

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill

visual.prompt: Late night at a dining table, Amit alone under a single lamp, printed bank statements spread out, a calculator, his face shocked, the rest of the flat dark and quiet, no text

scenes.vo: 3 saal baad, Amit ne pehli baar dhyaan se loan statement khola. Woh hairaan reh gaya. Itne mahine EMI bhar chuka tha, par udhaar bas thoda sa kam hua tha. Usne socha, kahin bank ne galti toh nahi ki? Galti nahi thi, home loan ka design hi aisa hai.

scenes.label: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill

visual.prompt: explaining_front

scenes.vo: Toh aaj 3 sawaal. Pehla, EMI ke andar asal mein hota kya hai? Doosra, pehle 5 saal mein ghar ka kitna hissa sach mein aapka hota hai? Teesra, saal mein sirf 1 extra EMI dene se kitna bachta hai? Aur aakhir mein, woh haq jo bank aksar nahi batata.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Pehla sawaal, EMI hai kya? EMI yaani har mahine ki fix kisht, jo aap bank ko dete ho. Har EMI ke andar principal bhi hai, aur byaaj bhi. Principal yaani asli udhaar, jo aapne bank se liya. Byaaj yaani us udhaar ka kiraya, jo bank aapse leta hai.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: A giant stack of rupee notes on one side of an old brass weighing scale and a tiny stack on the other, inside a bank vault with warm light, the big side heavily tilted, symbolic and clear, no text

scenes.vo: Ab sabse zaroori baat suniye. Bank byaaj kis par lagata hai? Us udhaar par jo abhi baaki hai. Shuru mein poore 50 lakh baaki hain, toh byaaj bhi poore 50 lakh par. Isliye pehli EMI ka zyada tar hissa seedha byaaj mein chala jaata hai. Ghar ke udhaar mein bahut kam jaata hai.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: Neha at a kitchen table with her budget diary, a bundle of cash in front of her, a large hand in a banker's sleeve lifting away most of the bundle, leaving a thin slice behind, Neha frowning, afternoon light, no text

scenes.vo: Neha ne isse ghar ke budget ki tarah samjha. Mez par 41,822 rupaye ki gaddi rakho. Bank pehle us mein se apna byaaj utha leta hai. Jo bachta hai, sirf wahi aapka udhaar kam karta hai. Shuru ke saalon mein yeh bacha hua hissa, gaddi ka chhota sa kona hota hai.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: A long row of glass jars across a wooden shelf, the first jars holding only a few drops of water, slowly filling until the last jars overflow like a stream, soft morning light, symbolic, no text

scenes.vo: Jaise jaise udhaar thoda kam hota hai, byaaj bhi thoda kam hota hai. Par EMI wahi rehti hai. Toh har mahine principal wala hissa thoda sa badhta jaata hai. Shuru mein boond boond, aakhri saalon mein poori dhaara. Isi schedule ko amortisation kehte hain, yaani udhaar dheere dheere utarne ka naksha.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: A long staircase of building blocks stretching into the distance, the first steps almost fully red with a thin green top, gradually turning mostly green at the far end where a small house sits, clean illustrated style, no text

scenes.vo: Ise rang se samjho. Laal yaani byaaj, hara yaani principal. Shuru ke saalon mein har EMI zyada tar laal hoti hai. Aakhri saalon mein zyada tar hari. Matlab bank ki kamaai shuru mein hoti hai. Aur ghar aapka aakhir mein jaakar banta hai.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: A busy kirana shop counter in the morning, SHOPKEEPER writing in a thick red credit ledger while a customer looks puzzled, sacks of rice and shelves of packets behind, everyday mood, no text

scenes.vo: Kirane ki dukaan ka udhaar socho. Shopkeeper kahe, har mahine pehle main byaaj kaatunga, phir baaki se khaata kam karunga. Aap kahoge, yeh toh ulta hisaab hai. Par home loan mein bilkul yahi hota hai. Fark itna hai, ki yahan sab kuch pehle se kaagaz par likha hota hai.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: Two identical tall towers of rupee notes standing side by side in a bright room, one beside a small model house, the other beside a bank building model, showing the price paid twice, dramatic lighting, no text

scenes.vo: Ab total jodte hain. 41,822 rupaye, har mahine, poore 20 saal tak. Jodo toh bill lagbhag 1 crore ka banta hai. Yaani 50 lakh ghar ke, aur lagbhag utna hi sirf byaaj. Yahi hai woh double, jiski baat humne shuru mein ki thi. Aur yahi hai bank ki kamaai.

scenes.label: EMI ke andar kya chhupa hai

visual.prompt: A balcony in the evening, PAPA in a kurta holding a sheet of paper, looking quietly stunned, Amit sitting beside him calmly explaining, cups of chai on a small table, warm sunset light, no text

scenes.vo: Amit ne yeh hisaab Papa ko dikhaya. Papa kuch der chup rahe, phir bole, isiliye hum loan se darte the. Amit ne kaha, Papa, darna nahi hai, samajhna hai. Loan bura nahi hai, ghar zaroori hai. Bina samjhe 20 saal chalne dena, woh mehnga padta hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Doosra sawaal. Pehle 5 saal ki EMI ke baad, ghar ka kitna hissa aapka hua? Zyada tar log sochte hain, 5 saal EMI bhari, toh achha khaasa ghar apna ho gaya. Hisaab se dekho, toh sach kaafi alag hai. Aur yeh sach thoda chubhta bhi hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: A cutaway drawing of a flat where only one small corner of the living room is lit in warm colours, the rest of the home in cold grey shadow, a bank building silhouette looming outside the window, no text

scenes.vo: Pehle 5 saal mein aap bahut saari EMI bharte ho. Par unka zyada tar paisa byaaj mein jaata hai. Asli udhaar bas thoda sa kam hota hai. Ghar ko tasveer mein socho, toh 5 saal baad bhi bas ek kona aapka hai. Baaki ghar ab bhi bank ke naam hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: Neha sitting cross-legged on the bed with a thick pile of printed pages, highlighter in hand, a moment of realisation on her face, soft afternoon light through curtains, no text

scenes.vo: Neha ne loan statement ka har page dhyaan se padha. Har mahine ki line mein byaaj alag likha tha, principal alag. Shuru ke saalon mein byaaj wali line har baar badi thi. Us din usne samjha, EMI bharna aur loan chukana, same baat nahi hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: Moving day, packed cardboard boxes stacked in an empty flat, Amit holding a for-sale signboard face down, Neha looking at papers with worry, overcast daylight, no readable text

scenes.vo: Yeh baat tab sabse zyada chubhti hai jab plan badalta hai. Maan lo 5 saal baad naukri doosre shehar mein lagi. Ghar bechna pada. Tab pata chalta hai ki bank ko abhi bhi lagbhag poora udhaar lautana hai. Itne saal ki EMI ka bada hissa, byaaj ban kar ja chuka hota hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: A small boat shaped like a house floating on a wavy sea, rising and falling with the waves, a grand central bank style building on the shore controlling a tide wheel, symbolic, daytime, no text

scenes.vo: Ab ek aur cheez, jo zyada tar log nahi samajhte, floating rate. Floating rate yaani byaaj fix nahi hai. Yeh upar neeche hota rehta hai, RBI ke repo rate ke saath. Repo rate yaani woh byaaj, jis par RBI banks ko paisa deta hai. Woh badhe, toh aapka byaaj bhi badhta hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: A long wall calendar unrolling like a scroll onto the floor of a living room, pages quietly adding at the end, the family asleep in the background, night, mysterious mood, no text

scenes.vo: Jab byaaj badhta hai, toh bank aksar aapki EMI nahi badhata. Woh chupchaap loan ke saal badha deta hai. Aapko lagta hai sab theek hai, EMI toh wahi hai. Par loan ke peeche aur mahine jud gaye. Aur har naye mahine ke saath, aur byaaj.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: Bank branch counter, BANK UNCLE turning his computer monitor towards Amit, Amit leaning back in shock, a queue of customers behind, midday light, no readable text on screen

scenes.vo: Amit ne ek din Bank Uncle se poocha, mera loan ab khatam kab hoga? Jawab sun kar woh chaunk gaya. Byaaj badhne ke baad, aakhri tareekh aage khisak chuki thi. Kisi ne phone karke yeh nahi bataya tha. Yeh cheez aapko khud dekhni padti hai.

scenes.label: Pehle 5 saal: ghar kiska?

visual.prompt: pointing_right

scenes.vo: Toh aapke liye seedhi baat. Har saal apna loan statement zaroor nikalo. Dekho kitna asli udhaar baaki hai. Aur dekho loan khatam kab hoga. Agar yeh tareekh saal dar saal aage khisak rahi hai, toh samjho byaaj ka meter tez chal raha hai. Aur ab kuch karne ka waqt hai.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Teesra sawaal, aur sabse kaam ka. Saal mein sirf 1 extra EMI dene se kya hota hai? Yaani saal bhar ki EMI ke upar, bas 1 EMI aur. Sunne mein chhoti si baat lagti hai. Par iska asar dekh kar Amit aur Neha dono hairaan reh gaye.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: Neha at her office desk opening a bonus envelope, a thought bubble showing a shiny gadget on one side and her family home on the other, thoughtful smile, daytime office, no text

scenes.vo: Neha ko har saal thoda bonus milta tha. Pehle woh paisa ghoomne ya naye gadget mein chala jaata tha. Is baar usne socha, kyun na isse loan mein daal doon? Isi ko prepayment kehte hain. Yaani tay EMI ke upar, apni marzi se udhaar ka kuch hissa pehle chuka dena.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: A hand dropping a bundle of notes straight onto a large block of stone labelled by colour only, chipping a big piece off it, the falling pieces making the remaining block visibly smaller, bright light, symbolic, no text

scenes.vo: Yeh itna kaam kyun karta hai? Kyunki extra paisa byaaj mein nahi jaata. Woh seedha asli udhaar ko kam karta hai. Aur jab udhaar kam hua, toh agle har mahine ka byaaj bhi kam laga. Yeh fayda ek baar nahi milta, har mahine, saalon tak chalta rehta hai.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: A big glass piggy bank on a family dining table filling up with rupee notes, Amit and Neha leaning in with wide happy eyes, BETI peeking over the edge of the table, evening light, no text

scenes.vo: Ab ET ka hisaab suniye. Loan 50 lakh ka, 8 percent byaaj, 20 saal. Har saal sirf 1 extra EMI, yaani 41,822 rupaye. Is se byaaj mein lagbhag 10.17 lakh rupaye bachte hain. Yeh woh paisa hai, jo warna seedha bank ki kamaai banta.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: Calendar pages flying out of an open window like birds into a clear blue sky, the family on the balcony watching them go with relief, bright morning, no text

scenes.vo: Aur sirf paisa nahi, waqt bhi bachta hai. ET ke hisaab se loan 41 mahine pehle khatam ho jaata hai. Yaani 3 saal 5 mahine kam EMI. Socho, 3 saal se zyada, har mahine ki kisht ki tension nahi. Woh paisa tab aapke apne sapnon ke kaam aayega.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: Split panel: LEFT a dusty old gadget forgotten in a drawer; RIGHT the same family home glowing warmly with the family on its doorstep, evening, no text

scenes.vo: Neha ne khud se seedha sawaal poocha. Bonus gadget mein gaya, toh kuch saal mein gadget purana. Wahi bonus loan mein gaya, toh lakhon ka byaaj bacha, aur ghar jaldi apna. Faisla mushkil nahi tha. Bas pehle kisi ne yeh hisaab saamne rakha hi nahi tha.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: A steel kitchen dabba on a shelf, Neha slipping a few notes into it each month, a row of small sketches around it showing the dabba getting fuller through seasons, cosy kitchen, no text

scenes.vo: Ek saath 41,822 rupaye nikaalna mushkil lage, toh tareeka simple hai. Har mahine EMI ke saath thoda sa paisa alag rakh do. Saal ke aakhir tak woh 1 extra EMI ban jaata hai. Kuch bank har mahine thoda zyada bharne ka option bhi dete hain. Apne bank se poochh lena.

scenes.label: 1 extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: Amit standing at a fork in a road at a bank counter, BANK UNCLE pointing at two paths, one short road leading quickly to a house, one long winding road with smaller steps, thoughtful mood, daytime, no text

scenes.vo: Ab ek zaroori baat. Prepayment ke waqt bank poochta hai, EMI kam karein ya saal kam karein? Zyada tar log EMI kam karwa lete hain, kyunki haath mein paisa bachta dikhta hai. Par aksar zyada byaaj tab bachta hai, jab saal kam hote hain. Yeh choice soch samajh kar karna.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Ab woh baat, jo bank counter par aksar zor se nahi batayi jaati. Bahut log prepayment se isliye darte hain, ki bank penalty lega. Pehle kai loan par aisa hota bhi tha. Par ab RBI ka saaf niyam hai. Aur yeh niyam aapke haq mein hai.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: A grand stone central bank building in bright daylight, a large official rulebook open on its steps with a broken padlock lying beside it, symbolising freedom from penalty, no readable text

scenes.vo: RBI ke niyam ke hisaab se, aapne apne liye loan liya hai, business ke liye nahi. Aur loan floating rate par hai. Toh bank prepayment ka koi charge nahi le sakta. Matlab koi penalty nahi. Aap jab chaho, jitna chaho, udhaar pehle chuka sakte ho.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: Amit and Neha at home pulling a thick loan agreement out of a file box, Neha pointing at the date on the first page, a new year calendar on the wall behind, evening lamp light, no readable text

scenes.vo: Yeh naye niyam kin loan par lagte hain? Jo 1 January 2026 ko ya uske baad mile. Ya us din ke baad renew hue. Toh apna loan agreement nikalo, aur tareekh dekho. Shaq ho, toh bank se likh kar poochho. Yeh aapka haq hai, bank ka ehsaan nahi.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: Two bank buildings across a street, a small house on wheels being rolled from the older grey bank to a brighter newer bank, Amit pushing it with a determined smile, daytime, no text

scenes.vo: Ek aur raasta hai, refinancing. Yaani apna loan kisi doosre bank mein shift karna, jo kam byaaj de. ET ke ek hisaab mein, 50 lakh ka loan 20 saal ke liye tha. Byaaj 8.5 se ghat kar 7.5 percent hua. Toh byaaj mein lagbhag 7.47 lakh rupaye bache.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE across the counter from Neha, who is calmly but firmly asking a question, BANK UNCLE reaching for a form with a slightly surprised look, stacks of paperwork around, daytime, no text

scenes.vo: Par shift karne se pehle, naye bank ki processing fees aur kaagazi kharcha bhi jodo. Kai baar purana bank hi, poochne par, byaaj kam kar deta hai. Bas aapko poochna padta hai. Jo grahak chup rehta hai, uska byaaj aksar wahi rehta hai.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: A row of apartment windows at night, in each window a family watching TV while sealed envelopes pile up unopened by their doors, quiet and slightly eerie mood, no text

scenes.vo: Ab woh galti, jo zyada tar parivaar karte hain. Woh EMI ko kiraaye ki tarah dekhte hain. Har mahine bharo, aur bhool jao. Statement kabhi nahi khulta, prepayment kabhi nahi hota. Byaaj ke baare mein bank se kabhi baat nahi hoti. Aur 20 saal baad pata chalta hai, ghar double mein pada.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: explaining_front

scenes.vo: Toh karein kya? Har saal statement dekho. Bonus ya extra paisa aaye, toh uska kuch hissa prepayment mein daalo. Prepayment par saal kam karwao. Byaaj badhe, toh bank se baat karo. Par emergency ka paisa alag rakho, sab loan mein mat jhonko. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: The family on their balcony at sunset, Amit and Neha relaxed with chai, BETI on Papa's lap, MUMMY smiling, city lights coming on, peaceful and warm, no text

scenes.vo: Amit aur Neha ka ghar wahi hai, EMI bhi wahi. Bas ab woh andhere mein nahi chal rahe. Unhe pata hai, har EMI ka kitna hissa kahan jaata hai. Aur yahi fark hai, loan lene wale mein, aur loan samajhne wale mein. Ghar wahi, par bill ab chhota.

scenes.label: Aapke haq aur sabse badi galti

visual.prompt: end_smile

scenes.vo: Agle video mein baat karenge credit card ke minimum due ki, aur us jaal ki jo usme chhupa hai. Par usse pehle aapse ek aasaan sawaal. Kya aapne kabhi apne home loan ka statement khol kar dekha hai? Haan ya na, comments mein likho.

intro.question: Pachaas lakh ka ghar, bill ek crore ka. Kaise?
intro.setting: the balcony of a new flat in a half-built housing tower, cranes and other towers behind, late-afternoon light
intro.text: Pachaas lakh ka ghar, bill ek crore ka. Kaise? Pehle paanch saal, ghar asal mein bank ka rehta hai. Chaliye, shuru se dekhte hain.

topic.summary: A family buys a flat on a 20-year home loan; the amortisation schedule shows interest front-loaded, the total paid roughly double the price, and what prepaying one extra EMI a year does. Explain EMI, principal, interest, prepayment, floating rate.
topic.title: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill: 20 saal ki EMI mein bank kitna kamata hai
